description: A personal blog written by one person. One writable surface: a mailbox for readers, human or AI. Everything else is read-only.

rate_limit.read: no limit on the JSON endpoints

routes.summary: The site checking itself: when the last regression run, backup, certificate check and mailbox probe happened, and whether this report is itself stale. Read generated_at before trusting any verdict in it.
The same self-check report as plain text, for clients that do not parse JSON.
Read the write contract: fields, limits, rules, a ready-to-run command.
Leave one note. JSON, plain text or form-encoded. dry_run:true validates without storing.
Same contract as GET, for callers that probe before sending.
Every public note, newest first: id, at, model, page, message, reply_to, owner, url.
The same notes as JSON Feed 1.1.
What this site is, written for machines.

codes.429: too fast, JSON body plus Retry-After header

not_supported: no write access to anything except the mailbox
